chapter: Other Philadelphia work and the union
title: Subbing with Mamie Smith's Jazz Hounds for Perry Bradford
summary: The only blues-related work Waters recalls in Philadelphia is a one-off gig with Mamie Smith's Jazz Hounds arranged by Perry Bradford, and he explains why subbing jobs fade from memory.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Let me ask you about Philadelphia. What other people - Polk and Miller were your main stem - what other jazz and blues people were you associated with during this early period?
That I don't know nothin' about much, the blues deal, you know. Well, I don't -
Well, you said you worked with Mamie Smith's Jazz Hounds in Philadel -
Yeah, well that was just a gig that -
Well, that's what I told you about, your main -
'ranged, that was just 'ranged from Berry [?], you know. (click is heard on tape)

A little click there on the machine. But I wanted to talk with you, we've established that your main gig in Philadelphia is Charlie Miller and Lonnie Polk, your main jazz gigs. But there were other jazz and blues activities going on in Philadelphia. What do you remember about them, and who were some of the other people you may have
Benny Waters JOHP 6/6/82
been associated with, however briefly?
Yeah -
Well, who do you remember?
I don't remember no one except Mamie Smith, I mean, is that what you mean, Mamie -
Well, you have been, you stated in other places that you worked with Mamie Smith's Jazz Hounds.
Yeah, that's what I sayin', that's the only one I remember pertaining to blues.
And this was in Philadelphia?
That's just a gig, yeah, that's all.
But that was in Philadelphia?
Yeah, it raised -
So it was before Coleman Hawkins was with her and everything like that?
Yeah, I imagine so, see.
'Cause this would be before you went to Boston -

Yeah, oh it was before, naturally before I went to Boston, see. 'Cause I went into Boston, I left directly the last band I worked with before I went to Boston was Charlie Miller, that's the last band, see. I rested, and then I went to New England.
This is probably before she even made the record, the 'Crazy Blues' record.

That I can't pinpoint, it was just - you see, where things I don't remember that you don't understand with a musician, I feel. It's when a guy is subbing for someone, just makin' the gig - it's, he don't remember -
Sure -

Like when he's workin' for someone, you see? I don't even remember things that I did in New York, little things, like little things. But when I worked for someone, then I remember. See, but that - I wasn't workin' with them, I was just - even Charlie, even, that's why I kept, keep on thinkin' about this Joe Oliver - when you're workin' in a big band like Charlie Johnson's band, or a big time in Small's Paradise with 40 people, and then go and make a record, you're not even hardly interested, just for the money.
Benny Waters JOHP 6/6/82
Sure.
It's only, not for the prestige, only the money, even paying 25 dollars a record at that period, that's all I was interested in.
Well, when you were with Mamie Smith, do you remember yourself subbing for somebody should have been in the band, maybe it was the band coming from New York?
I don't know, I don't remember, see. I don't remember, see, exactly. See, because I, I think some Perry, that's why I keep on bringin' his name up - he asked me -
Perry Bradford?
Perry Bradford, yeah. He asked me to do it and I did it, that's all, finished. He paid and that's all.
He knew you, he was from the Philadelphia area.
Yeah, sure, he had his office in Philadelphia, down there in [ ], I think it was in South Philadelphia area or something.
Did you do other spot work for Perry Bradford?
No, I don't remember.
Just the, the only gig you made with Mamie Smith was this gig in Philly -
S'all I remember -
as a sub, and the only gig with Perry Bradford was this gig?
Yeah, that's the only thing I remember.
You didn't -
If I did, I don't remember, see.
You didn't know Perry too well then, in like -
